svg.title: HYDRA-UMC architecture
svg.desc: HYDRA-UMC describes a CM5 host that talks to an STM32H745 over SPI, which drives up to eight Robot Controller Boards over one CAN bus; the repository holds the bootloaders with their signed-image rule, the SPI bridge on the CM5 and the host tools that sign and check images.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: A host, a real-time co-processor and up to eight robot boards: only the bootloaders and the SPI bridge exist as code today.
